{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id: keep row with highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is int64
data['sample_seq'] = data['sample_seq'].astype(int)

deduplicated = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now filter for severe patients
severe_patients = deduplicated[deduplicated['severity'] == 'severe']

# Exclude QC-failed baseline values (-999)
valid_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check number of valid severe patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of severe patients with valid baseline (after deduplication): {len(valid_severe)}")

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = valid_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) for severe patients (after deduplication): {mean_baseline}")

# Confirm units
print("Units of biomarker_baseline: ng/mL (per documentation, no correction needed)")"}
